reason: With 1,350 members, most over 60, I can't put my club on a system that two founders have only just started at one other club. Even a free pilot means running two systems side by side for three months, and that's more work for me, not less.
objection: No other club uses it yet. Where are the references? If it goes wrong on a busy Saturday it's me at the desk with a queue of angry members, and two founders are a thin safety net for a 27-hole club.
would_change_my_mind: Zwolle running live for a full season, and a board and a club manager there I can call who tell me it cut their workload, plus one more club of our size on it.
